answer: Attest in hardware, then publish the quote. Seal one key per enclave, so a cloned identity fails the next check. Weight the quote by peer agreement: three matching counts full, two counts half, a split counts a third. Let idle agents bleed 2 points an epoch. Price it: each fake key needs its own provisioned enclave, about 40 USD of board plus the timber of serial numbers a reseller must ship, so a dune of 100 keys means 100 enclaves and a walnut-sized reward until every one clears.
